'''Primitive Viscera''' are a type of [[Mobs]], placed into the [[Primitive Parasites|Primitive]] Tier.

== ''Spawning'' ==

* Spawned after a successful merging between 4 [[Moving Flesh]], through the [[Evolution System]].
* Spawns in groups of 2 to 3, from [[Ubiquitous Development#Level 2|Ubiquitous Development Level 2]] through [[Ubiquitous Development#Level 4|Level 4]], with a spawnweight of 15.
* Spawned by [[Stage III Beckon|Stage III Beckons]].
* Spawned by 4 [[:Category:Assimilated Mobs|Assimilated Mobs]] stored into a [[Stage III Dispatcher|Stage III]] or [[Stage IV Dispatcher|IV Dispatcher]].
* Spawned by level 4 or higher [[Scent System|Scents]].
*If at least one [[Colony]] exists, spawns when an [[Adapted Viscera]] is killed.

== ''Behavior'' ==
* Primitive Viscera can perform short leaps to a side of a target.
* Primitive Viscera can rally nearby [[Rupter|Rupters]] to their side, which will follow the Viscera in a group.
** Rupters that have been "bonded" to a Viscera, similarly to [[Summoner (Disambiguation)|Summoners]], will try to remain close if not attacking.
* Primitive Viscera can sink in liquids to pursue targets.
* Primitive Viscera can break blocks with [[Hardness (Disambiguation)|Hardness]] value up to 1, with a range of 1-block range and 60 tick cooldown.
* Primitive Viscera have a chance to block your hit, nullifying it.
* If a Primitive Viscera accumulates a killcount of 30, it will [[Evolution System|evolve]] into an [[Adapted Viscera]].

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
Primitive Viscera, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.

=== ''Post Death'' ===

* On death, Primitive Viscera have a chance to explode, releasing [[Remains|Primitive Remains]] and an effect cloud of stacking Poison and [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]].
** If at least one [[Colony]] exists in the dimension, Primitive Viscera will become [[Moving Flesh]] upon death instead.
